solvent.dielectric_context: use a defensible implicit-solvent representation of DCE and report it

scope: Model the pre-oxidation sequence from separated substrate + two BBr3 units through adduct, borenium, Wheland and borylation states. Oxidant, base and final deprotection are excluded.
energy_zero_definition: Use the separated neutral substrate plus two neutral BBr3 molecules as the reported energy zero.
